ld.name: NaturesPlus, Dreaminol®, Stress & Sleep Complex with Melatonin, 60 Capsules
ld.description: For Stress Related Sleep Issues Dietary Supplement Vegan Gluten Free Non-GMO NaturesPlus knows the importance of a good night's sleep. That's why our new Dreaminol® line of products has been formulated to support the restful, rejuvenating sleep you need so you can feel your best! As we know, it's difficult to fall asleep when you're stressed out, so let us help you calm down to relax mind and body, so you can drift off into dreamland. Dreaminol Stress & Sleep Complex with Melatonin is a blend of superior-quality chelated magnesium, the neurotransmitter GABA, the serotonin precursor 5-HTP, and other nutrients all working synergistically to maximize and expand the potential of Melatonin's effects to support deep, "dreamy" sleep! A clinically supported level of Melatonin helps you to enjoy deep, restful sleep and to wake up feeling non-groggy! Enjoy your mornings refreshed, re-energized and re-charged!

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 2 capsules before bedtime or as recommended by a qualified health care professional.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Vegetable cellulose, ascorbyl palmitate, silica and microcrystalline cellulose.
Free from synthetic colors, preservatives. Free from milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy and sesame.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep tightly closed in a cool, dry place. Keep out of reach of children.

May cause drowsiness. Do not use if pregnant, nursing or under 18. Consult doctor before use if you are taking any medications or have any medical conditions, including depression, seasonal affective disorder, schizophrenia, autoimmune disease, high blood pressure, asthma or epilepsy. Stop use and consult doctor if adverse reactions occur. Do not drive, operate machinery or consume alcohol while taking product. Allow a two-week break between two-month periods of daily use.
